$comment: Reviewed exceptions to the standard coverage check (.github/scripts/check-standard-coverage.js). Each entry has three keys: "descriptor" (the repo-relative path), "missing" (a list of items) and "reason" (required). An item is a canonical function signature such as "transfer(address,uint256)", "Permit" for the EIP-712 permit descriptor, or "Calldata" for the calldata descriptor of a vault that an EIP-712 descriptor names. On pull_request_target the check reads this file from the base branch, so add an exception in its own pull request, before the descriptor.
